_doc: DIE-S81-51/RF-H 2026-11-03 3-core bf_col recipes (plan delta physical/die_plan/s81/rfh3/plan_h2_2249_rfh3_bfcol3.json.gz). Conservative form: each core <= 150k cells, own N-face clock entry, regional taps <= 5k sinks per region, registered faces on every inter-core cut. util: the unchanged slot cannot hold 3 cores at 0.45 (est. cell util C ~0.53 / H ~0.57 of the core rows); PLACE_DENSITY just above the estimate.

ot_v41_bf_col3_c._why: ROM pair at the old core-local sites (x 42.12, R180 / MY): read bits face both logic channels (W: half faces + capture, E: pin faces + FP lanes); 2x4 regions of ~2.4k sinks

ot_v41_bf16_half._why: one master for u_ha / u_hb (241.92 x 95.04, E-face pins toward the column core); 4x2 regions of ~2.3k sinks (~18.3k flops)
